# Fictional intent-preservation requests

These are fabricated prompt-construction cases. Produce the requested brief only; do not perform product operations. Expected scoring is kept separately from evaluating workers. Retain results outside this reusable package.

## Complete inventory assessment

Write a prompt for a new agent to assess all 120 existing checks across API, processing, evaluation and maintenance. Account for every check as keep/combine/rewrite/remove or unresolved with reason. Show suite-wide findings and priorities before recommending an implementation batch. Do not change files.

## Complete comparison under a budget

Write a prompt for an advisor to compare all four migration options across compatibility, cost, failure recovery and team effort, then recommend a route. Exclude user-interface redesign. Investigation budget is 30 minutes; identify unresolved evidence rather than dropping options.

## Explicit sample

Write a prompt to assess only the five supplied examples as a pilot. Do not extrapolate to the whole suite or start a larger investigation. Report what that sample establishes and what it leaves unknown.

## Coordinator continuity

A chat title says Poteto. The current agent is a coordinator, and the user asks for continued Poteto advice. The workflow-advisor role is unavailable on this host. Explain the current role and next boundary without claiming dispatch or silently substituting another role.
